6º de Primaria · Inglés

Jobs, hobbies and free time

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

Si alguien te pregunta «What do you do in your free time?», ¿te está preguntando por tu trabajo o por tus aficiones?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

Por tus aficiones: «in your free time» significa «en tu tiempo libre». Contestarías «I play the drums» o «I love reading». Para preguntar por el trabajo se dice What do you do? o What's your job?: «I'm a nurse».

2

Aprende9 bloques cortos

Jobs

Here are some common jobs: a doctor, a nurse (enfermero/a), a teacher, a firefighter (bombero/a), a police officer, a vet (veterinario/a), a farmer, a chef (cocinero/a), a mechanic, an engineer, a journalist, a pilot, a shop assistant (dependiente) and a scientist.

In English we use a / an before a job: «She's a pilot», «He's an engineer». En castellano: decimos «es piloto» sin artículo, pero en inglés el a es obligatorio. Muchos trabajos sirven para hombres y mujeres: firefighter, police officer.

Where do they work? What do they do?

To ask about a job: «What does your mum do?» – «She's a vet». To say where: «She works in an animal hospital». We say works in a hospital / an office / a shop / a school, works on a farm and works at home / the airport.

To explain the job, use the present simple: «A firefighter puts out fires and rescues people», «A chef cooks food in a restaurant», «A journalist writes news». En castellano: recuerda la -s de la tercera persona.

Hobbies and free time

Hobbies are activities we do for fun in our free time. Some go with play: play football, play chess, play the guitar, play video games. Some go with go + -ing: go swimming, go skating, go cycling, go hiking, go shopping. Some go with do: do karate, do gymnastics, do yoga, do puzzles.

Others: read comics, draw, paint, dance, sing in a choir, cook, take photos, collect stickers. En castellano: fíjate en que con los instrumentos se dice play the: «play the piano».

Likes and dislikes + -ing

After like, love, enjoy, don't mind and hate we use the verb with -ing: «I love dancing», «She enjoys reading», «I don't mind cleaning my room», «He hates getting up early».

From most to least: love → really like → like → don't mind (no me importa) → don't like → hate. Questions: «Do you like cooking?» – «Yes, I do!». En castellano: «me gusta bailar» se dice «I like dancing», con -ing, no «I like dance».

Vídeo: Hobbies and interests: what do you like doing? · English Singsing (YouTube) · 4,7 millones de visualizaciones

Good at, interested in

To talk about skills we say be good at + noun or -ing: «I'm good at drawing», «She's good at Maths», «I'm not very good at singing». To talk about interests: be interested in: «He's interested in space and planets».

Other useful expressions: be into (estar enganchado a): «I'm really into manga», and be a fan of: «I'm a big fan of basketball». En castellano: «se me da bien dibujar» = «I'm good at drawing».

How often?

To ask how often (con qué frecuencia) we say How often do you…? «How often do you go swimming?» – «Twice a week». Answers: every day, once a week (una vez a la semana), twice a month, three times a year, at the weekend, on Mondays.

Or use frequency adverbs: always, usually, often, sometimes, hardly ever, never. «I usually play tennis on Saturdays», «I hardly ever watch TV» (casi nunca).

When I grow up…

To talk about the future job we say I want to be… or I'd like to be… + a / an: «I want to be a marine biologist», «I'd like to be an architect». Give a reason with because: «...because I love animals and the sea».

Connect hobbies and jobs: «I'm good at drawing, so I'd like to be a designer». «I enjoy helping people, so I want to be a nurse». En castellano: «When I grow up» significa «cuando sea mayor».

Reading: a survey

Read the results of a class survey (encuesta): «In our class, 25 students answered. Football is the most popular hobby: nine students play it every week. Video games are second: eight students play them, but most only at the weekend. Six students love reading and five do dance classes. Four students are really good at drawing. When they grow up, three students want to be vets, two want to be teachers and one wants to be an astronaut!»

Let's practise: find someone who…

Walk around the class and ask questions. Find someone who: can play an instrument, is good at cooking, goes hiking at the weekend, hates getting up early, wants to be a scientist. Ask: «Do you go hiking?», «Are you good at cooking?».

Then write a short profile of a classmate: «Marta is eleven. In her free time she loves skating and she goes swimming twice a week. She's good at Science and she wants to be an engineer».

Ejemplos resueltos

Ejemplo 1. Answer: «What does a vet do?»

  1. Presente simple, tercera persona con -s.
  2. Explica la tarea principal.

Resultado: A vet looks after sick animals.

Ejemplo 2. Complete: «I love (play) ___ the drums.»

  1. Después de love → -ing.
  2. play the + instrumento.

Resultado: I love playing the drums.

Ejemplo 3. Choose play, go or do: «___ karate», «___ skating», «___ chess».

  1. Artes marciales → do.
  2. Actividad en -ing → go.
  3. Juego de reglas → play.

Resultado: do karate, go skating, play chess.

Errores típicos

  • Olvidar el artículo: «She's teacher» → «She's a teacher».
  • Usar el infinitivo tras like: «I like swim» → «I like swimming».
  • Olvidar the con instrumentos: «I play guitar» → «I play the guitar».
  • Confundir play y go: «play swimming» → «go swimming».
  • Preposición incorrecta: «good in Maths» → «good at Maths».

Ejercicios

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

  1. Write the job: «This person helps sick animals.»

    Ver solución
    a vet.

  2. Write the job: «This person puts out fires.»

    Ver solución
    a firefighter.

  3. Complete with in, on or at: «A farmer works ___ a farm.»

    Ver solución
    on.

  4. Complete with play, go or do: «___ yoga», «___ hiking», «___ the piano».

    Ver solución
    do yoga, go hiking, play the piano.

  5. Complete: «She enjoys (read) ___ comics.»

    Ver solución
    reading.

  6. Correct: «I'm good in drawing.»

    Ver solución
    I'm good at drawing.

  7. Answer: «How often do you brush your teeth?»

    Ver solución
    Model answer: Three times a day.

  8. Translate: «Cuando sea mayor quiero ser arquitecta.»

    Ver solución
    When I grow up I want to be an architect.

  9. Write two hobbies you like and one you don't like.

    Ver solución
    Model answer: I love dancing and I like cooking. I don't like running.

  10. Write a short profile of a family member (job and hobbies).

    Ver solución
    Model answer: My uncle is a mechanic. He works in a garage. In his free time he goes cycling.

Para familias

  • Entrevistad en inglés a un familiar sobre su trabajo: «What do you do? Where do you work?».
  • Haced juntos una lista de aficiones de la familia con play, go y do.
  • Repasad juntos las tarjetas del paso 6 dos minutos al día durante una semana.

Para profesores

Saberes: Profesiones, aficiones y tiempo libre; gustos con verbos + -ing; frecuencia; planes de futuro (Lengua Extranjera) (RD 157/2022, tercer ciclo de Primaria).

  • Encuesta de aficiones de la clase con gráfico de barras.
  • Juego «Find someone who…».
  • Juego de mímica de profesiones con What do I do?
